declarations.name: AuiDiscussion

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible title and accessible name of the discussion.

inputs.name: comments
inputs.description: Comments: { id, parentId, author: { id, name, avatar? }, text, mentions?, createdAt, editedAt?, deleted?, replyCount? }.

inputs.name: currentUser
inputs.description: The signed-in user; null makes the discussion read-only (no composer, no reply).

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: Maximum characters per comment (1..100000); longer text is blocked from posting, not truncated.

inputs.name: showCounter
inputs.description: Show the character counter on every composer; requires maxLength.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.default: @ suggesting the people in the discussion
inputs.description: Mention triggers and providers of every composer (Mention Input).

inputs.name: allowReplies
inputs.description: Show Reply on comments.

inputs.name: canEdit
inputs.description: Whether the current user may edit a comment (deleted comments never).

inputs.name: canDelete
inputs.description: Whether the current user may delete a comment.

inputs.name: loadReplies
inputs.type: ((comment: DiscussionComment, context: DiscussionLoadContext) => Promise<readonly DiscussionComment[]>) | null
inputs.description: Loads replies of a comment whose replyCount exceeds its loaded replies; context { signal, loaded }.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: loading shows a spinner, error a message with Retry (aui-retry).

inputs.name: errorText
inputs.description: Message shown with status error.

inputs.name: emptyTitle
inputs.description: Empty state title.

inputs.name: emptyDescription
inputs.description: Empty state description.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Placeholder of the new-comment box.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Rows of every composer (1..20).

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Names holidays and non-working days in absolute dates.

inputs.name: now
inputs.description: Reference time of relative timestamps; default now, refreshed every minute.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: maxIndent
inputs.description: Levels that indent (1..10); deeper replies show Replying to <name>.

inputs.name: collapseDepth
inputs.description: Replies of comments at this depth or deeper start collapsed (1..50; top-level is depth 0).

inputs.name: pageSize
inputs.description: Top-level comments shown at first and per Show more comments (1..500).

inputs.name: repliesPageSize
inputs.description: Replies shown per thread at first and per Show more replies (1..200).

inputs.name: showAvatars
inputs.description: Show avatars.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading level of the title (2..6).

inputs.name: composerPosition
inputs.description: Where the new-comment box sits.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone of timestamps.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of labels, numbers, and dates.

models.name: sort
models.description: Order of top-level comments (replies are always oldest first).

outputs.name: posted
outputs.description: A top-level comment was posted: { comment }; prevent it to add nothing and keep the text.

outputs.name: replied
outputs.description: A reply was posted: { comment, parent }.

outputs.name: edited
outputs.description: An edit was saved: { id, text, mentions, previous }; prevent it to keep the previous text.

outputs.name: deleted
outputs.description: A delete was confirmed: { comment, placeholder } (placeholder: the comment has replies and stays as deleted).

outputs.name: expandToggled
outputs.description: A thread was expanded or collapsed: { id, expanded }.

outputs.name: mentioned
outputs.description: From the composers (Mention Input): a mention was inserted: { mention }.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Add a comment or replace the one with the same id; comments by others are announced.

methods.name: removeComment
methods.description: Remove a comment (no event): a placeholder when it has replies, otherwise gone with deleted ancestors left without replies.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Show a thread's replies (loading them when needed).

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Open and focus the reply box of a comment.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the new-comment box (or the first comment when read-only).

accessibility.pattern: A labelled region with nested lists of articles (one list per reply level, so the nesting is semantic at every depth); every action is a native button in the Tab order, the composers are labelled multi-line text fields with mention suggestions (Mention Input, combobox-style listbox), and thread toggles are disclosure buttons. The WAI-ARIA tree pattern was not used because comments contain interactive content (buttons, links, text fields), which tree items must not.

limitations: Not virtualized: the DOM grows as the user pages in more comments or expands threads.
Replies are always in conversation order (oldest first); sort applies to top-level comments.
One reply, edit, or delete panel is open at a time; an unsent reply is kept as a draft when another panel opens.
